Session for the Yubico OTP application on the YubiKey.
YubiOTP.Session programs the YubiKey’s two OTP slots for Yubico OTP, HOTP, static passwords,
or HMAC-SHA1 challenge-response. Keyboard configurations use a short touch for slot 1 and a long
touch for slot 2. These slots are separate from the credentials managed by
